GitHub Copilot Login Documentation 
1. Accepting the Copilot Invitation 
• 
You will receive an invitation to join Godigit-General-Copilot. 
 
• 
Click the invitation link to join. 
• 
If you already have a Copilot account, sign in. Otherwise, create a new account. 
 
• 
When creating your account, use the username format: EmpId-Name. 
• 
After creating your account, confirm your email address and sign in. 
•

• 
Go back to the invitation email and click the link again to join Godigit-General-Copilot. 
 
• 
Accept the invitation to complete the process.

2. Using Copilot in VS Code 
• 
Open VS Code and click Sign in to use Copilot. 
 
• 
Click Continue with GitHub. 
 
• 
Sign in with your Copilot account. 
 
• 
Click Open when prompted. 
 
 


3. Using Copilot in IntelliJ 
• 
Go to Settings → Plugins. 
• 
Install the Copilot extension. 
 
• 
Sign in to Copilot. 
 
• 
Click Copy & Open when prompted. 
 
• 
Enter the copied code and continue.

• 
Click Authorize. 
 
 
After completing these steps, you can use Copilot. 
If you have any questions, please watch this video: 
https://youtu.be/n0NlxUyA7FI?si=MfWV99XgKI0a6-OJ
